metadata_system.name: MIME Metadata
metadata_system.used_for: Emails and attachments — IANA media-type registry (application/* tree)
metadata_system.description: MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) media types are the official content-type designators used in email, HTTP, and many other protocols. The 'application/*' tree alone has hundreds of registered subtypes. This entry covers all registered types in the application namespace; combine with system 089/086 for full message metadata.
